extra_vocab.en: related to selling goods to customers in stores or online
extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡 retail 修飾 industry，指「零售業」，是商業新聞常見的產業名稱。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: retail 修飾名詞時不加 s（retail industry）；要表示「零售商」要用 retailer。

example.en: This model retails for about two hundred dollars in most stores.
example.zh: 這個型號在大多數店裡零售價約兩百美元。

example.en: The jacket retailed for eighty dollars last year.
example.zh: 這件外套去年的零售價是八十美元。

example.en: Our company is retailing its products through online stores.
example.zh: 我們公司正透過網路商店零售產品。

example.en: The retail price is higher than the wholesale price.
example.zh: 零售價比批發價高。

example.en: The retail store opens at ten o'clock every morning.
example.zh: 這家零售店每天早上十點開門。

example.en: Retail sales rose by five percent in the last quarter.
example.zh: 上一季零售額成長了百分之五。

examples.en: She has ten years of experience in retail management.
examples.zh: 她有十年零售管理的經驗。

examples.en: Retail shops are adding mobile payment to attract more customers.
examples.zh: 零售店正加入行動支付以吸引更多顧客。

confusable.diff: retain 是「保留、留住」，拼法與發音都和 retail 很像。

example.en: We want to retain our best employees this year.
example.zh: 我們今年想留住最優秀的員工。

confusable.diff: wholesale 是批發，和 retail 零售正好相反。

example.en: The store buys goods at wholesale prices from the factory.
example.zh: 這家店以批發價向工廠進貨。

example.en: Every customer received a coupon at the register.
example.zh: 每位顧客在結帳時都拿到一張優惠券。

example.en: The store will close early on Friday evening.
example.zh: 這家店星期五晚上會提早打烊。

example.en: The retailer offered a discount on all winter coats.
example.zh: 這家零售商提供所有冬季外套折扣。

derived.link: retail + -ing，把這件事變成名詞，像 marketing

example.en: Online retailing has grown quickly in the past five years.
example.zh: 網路零售在過去五年快速成長。

example.en: The retail sector hired many extra workers for the holidays.
example.zh: 零售業為了假期僱用了許多額外的員工。

example.en: The company sells its products at retail rather than wholesale.
example.zh: 這家公司以零售而非批發的方式銷售產品。

example.en: The new tablet will retail for four hundred dollars.
example.zh: 這款新平板的零售價會是四百美元。

extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡 caused a revolution 是「引起一場變革」，cause 後面直接接結果當受詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: cause + 受詞 + to V（caused him to leave），不能寫 cause him leave；cause 後面的結果通常是不好的事，好結果常用 bring about 或 lead to。

example.en: Heavy traffic often causes delays for our delivery trucks.
example.zh: 嚴重的車流常讓我們的送貨卡車延誤。

example.en: We are studying the causes of the drop in sales.
example.zh: 我們正在研究業績下滑的原因。

example.en: The software error is causing problems for many customers.
example.zh: 這個軟體錯誤正給許多客戶帶來問題。

example.en: Bad weather may cause a delay in the shipment.
example.zh: 壞天氣可能造成貨運延誤。

example.en: The heavy rain caused damage to the warehouse.
example.zh: 大雨對倉庫造成了損害。

example.en: The schedule change caused confusion among team members.
example.zh: 時間表的變動讓團隊成員感到混亂。

examples.en: The error caused several customers to receive the wrong invoice.
examples.zh: 這個錯誤使幾位客戶收到錯的發票。

examples.en: Rising costs caused the company to raise its prices.
examples.zh: 成本上升使公司調高價格。

confusable.diff: because 是連接詞，後面接子句；cause 是動詞或名詞，兩者字形相近。
confusable.usage: because 後面接完整子句，cause 當動詞要接受詞。

example.en: We postponed the meeting because the manager was sick.
example.zh: 因為經理生病，我們延後了會議。

confusable.diff: cause 是原因，effect 是結果，常成對出現。

example.en: The new policy had a positive effect on sales.
example.zh: 新政策對銷售有正面的影響。

similar.diff: lead to 語氣中性，可以接好或壞的結果；cause 通常接不好的結果。

example.en: Poor planning can lead to serious delays in production.
example.zh: 規劃不良可能導致生產嚴重延誤。

similar.diff: result in 較正式，常用在報告與書信，後面接結果。

example.en: The change will result in lower costs for customers.
example.zh: 這項改變會讓客戶的成本降低。

example.en: Please explain the reason for the late delivery.
example.zh: 請說明延遲交貨的理由。

example.en: The test result will arrive by e-mail tomorrow.
example.zh: 測試結果明天會用電子郵件寄到。

example.en: Please do not let small errors cause big problems.
example.zh: 請不要讓小錯誤造成大問題。

example.en: We are still looking for the cause of the system error.
example.zh: 我們仍在尋找系統錯誤的原因。

extra_vocab.en: to get an answer after you asked or sent something
extra_vocab.note: 在這句裡 as soon as I hear back 是「一收到對方回覆」，是電子郵件與工作聯絡中常見的口氣，專業又自然。
extra_vocab.pattern: I will + V + as soon as I hear back (from 人)
extra_vocab.grammar_note: as soon as 引導的時間子句用現在式代替未來式，要寫 as soon as I hear back，不寫 will hear back；回覆的對象常用 from + 人。

examples.en: Please let me know when you hear back from the supplier.
examples.zh: 你收到供應商的回覆時，請通知我。

examples.en: I have not heard back from the company about my interview.
examples.zh: 關於我的面試，我還沒收到那家公司的回覆。

examples.en: We will book the flights once we hear back from Singapore.
examples.zh: 我們一收到新加坡那邊的回覆，就會訂機票。

similar.diff: get a reply 意思相同，語氣稍正式，後面可接 from + 人。

example.en: I hope to get a reply from the client by Friday.
example.zh: 我希望星期五前能收到客戶的回覆。

similar.diff: get back to 的主詞是「回覆的人」；hear back 的主詞是「等回覆的人」。

example.en: I will get back to you with the price tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 我明天早上會回覆你價格。

confusable.diff: hear from 是「收到某人的消息」，不一定是回覆；hear back 一定是對你先前的詢問的回覆。

example.en: It was nice to hear from you after so many months.
example.zh: 隔了這麼多個月再收到你的消息真好。

confusable.diff: hear about 是「聽說某件事」，後面接事情，不接回覆的人。

example.en: Did you hear about the new office in Singapore?
example.zh: 你有聽說新加坡新辦公室的事嗎？
